CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.product_performance
(
    product_id INT ,
    product_name VARCHAR(100) ,
    category_name VARCHAR(100) ,
    brand VARCHAR(100) ,
    total_orders BIGINT ,
    total_units_sold BIGINT ,
    gross_sales DECIMAL(34,2) ,
    total_discount DECIMAL(23,2),
    total_tax DECIMAL(23,2),
    net_sales DECIMAL(36,2) ,
    average_selling_price DECIMAL(34,2)
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'synapse_serving/product_performance/',
    DATA_SOURCE = EcommerceGold,
    FILE_FORMAT = ParquetFormat
)


SELECT TOP 10 * FROM dbo.product_performance
